title: Oily Jamaican Cod Curry
description: A peppery, juicy, lazy-sunday Jamaican dish featuring English mustard and fermented kimchi, cooked in a bamboo steamer for a silky finish.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok over medium heat and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the mixed spice blend and cook for another minute, letting the spices toast.
Add the chopped kimchi and red bell pepper, cooking until the pepper softens about 3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring to combine the flavors.
Gently fold in the cod fillets, ensuring they are submerged in the sauce.
Cover the wok and steam the curry in a bamboo steamer set over simmering water for 10 minutes, or until the cod flakes easily.
Remove from heat, season with salt, drizzle with English mustard, and sprinkle fresh cilantro before serving.
